c74object.name: el.chopper~
c74object.digest: Algorithmic buffer chopper and loop granulator
c74object.description:
el.chopper~ plays algorithmic, randomly selected slices from an audio buffer with smooth crossfading envelopes and optional loop locking. Slices can be locked, randomized, stored, recalled, modified in real time, and synchronized across multiple instances. Double-clicking the object opens the display window of the referenced buffer~.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (messages / bang): Force new loop / message inlet. Accepts commands (bang, newloop, set, chopspec, etc.) or a bang to immediately select and trigger a new loop segment.
Inlet 2 (float): Minimum playback increment factor (speed / transposition).
Inlet 3 (float): Maximum playback increment factor (speed / transposition).
Inlet 4 (float): Minimum segment duration in milliseconds.
Inlet 5 (float): Maximum segment duration in milliseconds.
Inlet 6 [Rightmost Inlet] (int / float): Loop lock switch (1 locks the current loop so it repeats; 0 unlocks to resume random segment selection).
Outlets
Audio Outlets [Leftmost] (signal): Audio output for each buffer channel. The total number of signal outlets is set by the second object argument (default: 1).
Sync Outlet [Rightmost] (list): Sync data outlet. Emits synchronizing state data formatted as a sync_in message when sync_out is received.

inlet.description: Receives messages to control playback parameters. A bang or newloop immediately selects and triggers a new loop slice.
Sets the lower bound for the random playback increment / transposition factor (minimum 0.005).
Sets the upper bound for the random playback increment / transposition factor (maximum 20.0).
Sets the lower bound for the random segment duration in milliseconds (minimum 30 ms).
Sets the upper bound for the random segment duration in milliseconds (maximum 120,000 ms).
Non-zero locks the current loop so it repeats continuously. 0 releases the lock and resumes random segment selection upon loop completion.

outlet.description: Audio signal output from the buffer player. When multi-channel buffers are loaded and channel count argument is greater than 1, separate signal outlets are created for each channel.
Emits synchronization data formatted as a sync_in message when sync_out is received. Connect this to another el.chopper~ instance to duplicate loop parameters and sample phase.

objarg.name: buffer-name
objarg.description: The name of the buffer~ object to read audio samples from.

objarg.name: channel-count
objarg.description: The number of audio output channels (default: 1). This should match the number of channels in the target buffer~.

objarg.name: fade-time
objarg.description: The envelope taper / crossfade duration in milliseconds applied at the start and end of each slice (default: 20.0 ms).

method.name: adjust_inverse
method.description: When set to 1 and increment_adjust is enabled, changes to fixed_increment will scale loop size inversely.

method.name: bang
method.description: Immediately selects and crossfades into a new random loop segment.

method.name: chopspec
method.description: Sets loop range limits via a 4-element list: [minimum_increment, maximum_increment, minimum_segdur_ms, maximum_segdur_ms].

method.name: fixed_increment
method.description: Sets a fixed playback speed/transposition increment. Setting this to 0 disables fixed increment mode and restores random increment selection.

method.name: increment_adjust
method.digest: Compensate loop duration when increment changes
method.description: When set to 1, changing the playback increment will dynamically adjust the loop length in samples so that loop duration remains constant.

method.name: jitter
method.digest: Random deviation in loop start time
method.description: Amount of random deviation applied to the loop start position (0.0 to 1.0).

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes DSP computation and outputs silence. 0 restores normal playback.

method.name: newloop
method.description: Identical in operation to bang. Forces the selection of a new loop segment.

method.name: rdur
method.description: Percentage of random deviation applied to loop duration upon repetition (0.0 to 1.0).

method.name: recall_loop
method.description: Recalls and crossfades into a loop previously saved using store_loop (slot index 0 to 1023).

method.name: retro_odds
method.description: Sets the probability (0.0 to 1.0) that a randomly chosen loop segment will be played backwards.

method.name: rinc
method.description: Percentage of random deviation applied to the increment factor upon loop repetition (0.0 to 1.0).

method.name: set
method.description: Changes the source buffer~ object to a new buffer name.

method.name: set_loop
method.description: Directly sets the active loop using a 3-element list: [start_frame, sample_count, increment].

method.name: show_loop
method.description: Prints the current loop start frame, sample count, and increment to the Max Console.

method.name: store_loop
method.description: Stores the current loop's start frame, sample count, and increment into memory slot index 0 to 1023.

method.name: sync_in
method.description: Synchronizes this object's playback state with another el.chopper~ instance sharing the same buffer. Connect the controlling object's sync outlet to this message.

method.name: sync_out
method.description: Emits the current loop and phase parameters out of the sync data outlet.

method.name: taper
method.description: Sets the crossfade / fade-in / fade-out duration of the segment smoothing envelope in milliseconds.

attribute.name: amplitude_deviation
attribute.description: Random amplitude deviation factor (0.0 to 1.0, default: 0.0). When non-zero, each new loop slice will have its gain randomly attenuated between (1.0 - amplitude_deviation) and 1.0.

attribute.name: dropout_odds
attribute.description: Probability (0.0 to 1.0, default: 0.0) that any given loop slice will drop out to silence instead of playing.

attribute.name: minimum_increment
attribute.description: Minimum random playback speed/transposition increment factor (default: 0.8).

attribute.name: maximum_increment
attribute.description: Maximum random playback speed/transposition increment factor (default: 1.2).

attribute.name: minimum_segdur
attribute.description: Minimum segment duration in milliseconds (default: 250.0 ms).

attribute.name: maximum_segdur
attribute.description: Maximum segment duration in milliseconds (default: 2000.0 ms).
